entries.summary: Removed the opt-in change-freeze in the unified-skillpack conformance check (tools/validate_unified_skillpacks.py, from the now-inert .claude/skillpacks/ migration). It fail-closed on any file changed outside a fixed allowed_change_paths list since a pinned base commit whenever a branch matched chore/unified-skillpacks-v1.0.0-* or CI passed --enforce-change-scope. Removed the enforce_change_scope/change_base parameters, the CLI flags, and the corresponding workflow conditional; replaced with a passive, non-enforcing record of files changed since the pinned base. This governance/change_log.json file is introduced at the same time as the self-tracker every federation repo now carries.

Adopted the change-coupled documentation gate defined by thehub-pr ADR 0010: the shared tools/check_docs_sync.py, a docs-sync workflow, a Claude Code Stop hook, CLAUDE.md, and this repo's .federation/docs-sync.json. Re-pinned PRII_TEMPLATE_REF to thehub-pr a86951e, which also brings in the hub's pip-audit baseline fix (the Report step now fails the job when pip-audit produced no report; findings stay report-only). Tooling and workflow change only: no contract, schema or dependency edge changed. PROVISIONAL until docs-sync is a required status check on main.
